verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state issuing Visa debit or credit cards with defined roles and spend limits, real-time tracking (relay-docs-2), physical/virtual card issuance up to 50 cards (relay-docs-16), and card freeze/replacement management (relay-docs-8). Community evidence corroborates card limits and permissions in practice (relay-comm-4, relay-comm-2). Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of role-based permission granularity and credit card specifics beyond marketing copy.
